id: D72-02 (on/off words from before 0.1.6: config_note rows from the helper, the resume_proceed note, restart_on_update's /config line, migrate on two option keys)
note: D-72 review: Claude Code drops a saved value outside the options before the hooks get it, so the helper is the reader that sees an old word (settings file, flag, env). rc::preamble writes one config_note {key, note: legacy-word} per key and session (legacy-on for idle_handoff_turn "on", as config.ts notes it) for an old form in a source read for that key; a file-only key's flag or env is not read, so it gets none. A flag or env resume_proceed in an old form gets the same 'old value' note as the other keys. restart_on_update stays in the manifest (D-72 root correction: the owner sets shadow in /config), so its consent refusal and its saved-empty warning name /config and the configure line like any consent key. `settings migrate` with two option keys for the plugin refuses with the reason instead of saying nothing is old.

steps.name: status: old words saved in the file, one config_note row per key (legacy-on for idle_handoff_turn on); a value already true or false gets none
the same session again: still one row per key
env in an old form: a note and a row each, resume_proceed too; a file-only key's env is not read, so no row

stdout_has: ^note: precompact_turn: the old value model reads as true$
^note: resume_proceed: the old value confirm reads as false$

steps.name: settings set restart_on_update (consent, in the manifest): /config and the configure line

stdout_has: ^  restart_on_update: a consent key; [^\n]*Change it yourself in /config \(the row $BRAND\.restart_on_update\) or in your settings\.json by hand$
^  restart_on_update: or type: ! printf '%s' '\{"restart_on_update":"shadow"\}' \| claude plugin configure '$BRAND@m' --values-stdin$

steps.name: settings set relaunch_auto (consent, in the manifest): /config and the configure line as before

stdout_has: ^  relaunch_auto: a consent key; [^\n]*Change it yourself in /config \(the row $BRAND\.relaunch_auto\) or in your settings\.json by hand$
^  relaunch_auto: or type: ! printf '%s' '\{"relaunch_auto":"off"\}' \| claude plugin configure '$BRAND@m' --values-stdin$

steps.name: restart_on_update saved empty: the warning names /config or the file (a consent key)

stdout_has: ^warning: restart_on_update: saved empty, the plugin uses the default; Claude Code passes "" to the hooks; clear it with /config or by hand \(a consent key: the plugin never writes it\)$

steps.name: settings migrate with two option keys for the plugin: refused, the reason named

stdout_has: \Asettings migrate: refused, several plugin option keys in your settings\.json \("$BRAND@m", "$BRAND@n"\); remove the one no longer used, then run this again$
stdout_lacks: no saved value is in a form
